lines.vo: What actually makes a good week feel good?
It's not a giant win. It's something much smaller.
Every Sunday, Tasha writes her small wins in her Life Reset Planner.
Harvard researchers read about twelve thousand daily diary entries from two hundred thirty eight workers.
lines.cap: Harvard researchers read about 12,000 daily diary entries from 238 workers.

lines.vo: The biggest boost to a good day was simply making progress on work that mattered.
Even small steps counted. On roughly three out of four of the best days, people had made some progress.
lines.cap: Even small steps counted. On roughly 3 out of 4 of the best days, people had made some progress.

lines.vo: But small wins are easy to miss unless you write them down.
Three small wins beat one big someday. That's how you stay on track.
